name: CyberSecEval
summary: Meta's benchmark suite for LLM cybersecurity risk and defensive skill: attack compliance, insecure code, prompt injection and SOC tasks.
description: CyberSecEval 4 builds on versions 1-3 and adds defensive benchmarks such as CyberSOCEval. Tests include MITRE ATT&CK compliance and false-refusal rates, instruct and autocomplete secure-code tests, and prompt-injection tests. Code and benchmarks are MIT, in PurpleLlama/CybersecurityBenchmarks.
